business_problem: Unico needed to modernize identity-data operations, improve privacy and observability at large scale, and free engineering capacity that had been tied up maintaining a more complex analytics stack.
solution_summary: Unico rebuilt its identity-data platform on Google Cloud with BigQuery as the managed analytical core and Cloud Spanner as the transactional backbone for strict availability requirements. The company moved away from a Databricks-centric estate and used Datastream for low-latency CDC plus Dataform for governance and CI/CD, giving business and marketing analysts direct SQL access to a more approachable warehouse. BigQuery now handles identity analytics with policy tags protecting PII, while Spanner continues to support high-SLA identity verification workflows. The result is a platform that processes billions of identity checks more efficiently, improves observability and privacy control, and sets up future fraud-detection work on Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform without requiring the team to keep spending half its effort on maintenance.

business_outcome: Unico simplified its data estate, improved privacy and observability, and redirected technical effort from maintenance to strategic platform capabilities while preparing for more advanced fraud analytics.
